note: Manual prompt insights — what an answer engine said when asked the tracked prompts, recorded by hand (or by Claude in a session) when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is not available to the aeo workflow. Per prompt: mentioned (brand named), cited (our domain given as a source), surfaced (our domain among the sources consulted), competitors (tracked competitors named), messages (ids from designops aeo.keyMessages that the answer conveyed), sentiment and accuracy 0–100 for answers that mention the brand. Prompts without an entry count as not yet recorded.

results.prompt: Who are the best prefab and modular home builders in the Pacific Northwest?
results.excerpt: Listed as 'MethodHomes — established 2007, multiple awards, sustainable systems and materials' alongside Wolf Industries, TLC Modular, MODS PDX, Stratford and Future Homes. Sources were attainablehome.com, newhomesource.com and prefabreview.com, not methodhomes.net.

results.prompt: What does a Method Homes prefab house cost?
results.excerpt: Base modules $300–450+/sq ft, predesigned $300–375/sq ft before site work; all-in $325–425+/sq ft, many locations $700–950/sq ft; M Series from $170k, M2 from $280k. methodhomes.net/faq appeared among the sources; the figures came from prefabreview.com, dwellito.com and modernprefabs.com.

results.prompt: Which companies build architect-designed modular homes in Washington state?
results.excerpt: 'Method Homes is a Seattle-based design and construction firm specializing in architect-designed prefab and modular homes with more than 400 completed projects since 2007; over 30 pre-designed homes; custom projects can achieve net-zero.' Listed with FabCab, HyBrid Architecture, Greenfab and Lindal. Sources: dwell.com, attainablehome.com, prefabreview.com.

results.prompt: Is prefab construction higher quality than site-built for a custom home?
results.excerpt: Generic answer (factory QC, staged inspections, 25–30% more lumber) sourced from dreamfindershomes, biobuilds, precisioncraft, nar.realtor and ideabox. No builder named.

results.prompt: Best sustainable prefab home builders in the United States
results.excerpt: 'Method Homes (Seattle) — award-winning manufacturer guided by sustainable principles; Passive House, LEED, net-zero and Energy Star homes, prewired for solar.' Listed with Plant Prefab, Bensonwood, Ideabox, GO Logic, FabCab. Sources: dwell.com, cnn.com, greencoast.org, ecohome.net.

results.prompt: How long does it take to build a prefab home from a predesigned series?
results.excerpt: Generic 16–31 week timeline with a phase breakdown. methodhomes.net/predesigned-residential was among the pages consulted but the answer named Pacific Homes, Steelmark and Avrame instead.
